caso-01.title: Dental rejuvenation & ceramic veneers
caso-01.description: Anatomical restoration of worn incisal edges. Custom ceramic laminates restored natural length, texture and light reflection for a rejuvenated, harmonious smile.

caso-03.title: Micro-aesthetics & incisal edge leveling
caso-03.description: Correction of micro-fractures, uneven incisal edges and irregular shade. Ultra-thin laminates restore continuity and a smooth line to the smile.

caso-04.title: Optical alignment & contact aesthetics
caso-04.description: A cosmetic solution for mild crowding and tooth-axis discrepancies without invasive reduction, optimizing how light reflects for a uniform smile.

caso-05.title: Midline diastema closure with no-prep veneers
caso-05.description: A graceful closure of the gap between the front teeth, optimizing tooth proportions. Ultra-thin no-prep ceramic veneers were used, keeping the natural tooth structure intact.

caso-07.title: Metal-free fixed anterior rehabilitation
caso-07.description: Old, poorly fitting restorations replaced with high-strength biomimetic ceramic structures, restoring chewing function, lip support and aesthetics.

caso-08.title: Reconstruction of a fractured tooth
caso-08.description: Anatomical and structural recovery of a fractured front tooth with a pure ceramic restoration, eliminating unsightly shadows and restoring the original anatomy.

caso-09.title: Correction of crowding & arch expansion
caso-09.description: Correction of malocclusion and severe crowding, restoring width to the upper arch, functional symmetry and a bright, radiant smile.
